{{Quote|All visitors will rest easy knowing that the Selkath Security Forces are always alert and watchful, even while you sleep. Our constant vigilance keeps the peace on the streets of Ahto City and prevents the needless interruption of commerce by violence.|Manaan Visitor's Guide|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Selkath Security Force''' was the [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] organization of [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]. They detained individuals who disrupted the peace between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] on Manaan.
